tools.name: trade_guard
tools.description: Use it for every pre-execution trust decision: one oracle price, price analytics, oracle health, oracle registry search, a venue market quote, or the pre-trade safety gate including prepare_swap and prepare_perp_order. Each call selects the branch with "op". Do not use it to prove execution after the fact (use trade_proof), to poll a prepaid monitoring window (use oracle_watch_window), or to manage a position bundle (use position_lifecycle). Returns the op payload: price and analytics rows for read ops, a venue quote for market_quote, a READY/CAUTION/BLOCK verdict with reasons for check_safety, and an unsigned prepared transaction, Solana message, venue order or instruction for prepare_* ops. Absorbs the deprecated names get_oracle_price, get_price_analytics, get_oracle_health, search_oracle_registry, get_market_quote, check_trade_safety, prepare_swap and prepare_perp_order. Metering: oracle_price, market_quote and search_registry are 2 credits ($0.002); price_analytics and oracle_health are 4 credits ($0.004); check_safety, prepare_swap and prepare_perp_order are 40 credits ($0.040), the product ceiling. Deprecated alias spellings keep their original tiers until 2027-01-06.

tools.name: trade_proof
tools.description: Use it to open a trade-evidence session, issue an execution receipt, or verify an evidence artifact after a trade. Each call selects the branch with "op": begin_evidence, issue_receipt or verify_evidence. Do not use it to decide whether a trade is safe before signing (use trade_guard) and do not use it to settle a swap guard (use the venue guard tools). Returns the evidence session handle, the signed receipt, or the verification verdict, digest and matched evidence. Absorbs the deprecated names begin_trade_evidence, issue_execution_receipt and verify_evidence. Metering: begin_evidence and issue_receipt are C4 (40 credits / $0.040); verify_evidence is free for the three offline kinds (execution_pair, base_agent_swap, solana_swap) and C4 for live reads.

tools.name: oracle_watch_window
tools.description: Oracle Watch for monitored trust signals. Use it to read one trust snapshot or history series, buy a 24h monitored window, or poll/close an already purchased window. Each call selects the branch with "op": snapshot, history, begin, poll or close. Do not use it for pre-trade safety (use trade_guard op check_safety), do not buy a second window for the same subject, and never reuse a token after close. Returns the trust signal or history series, the windowId plus one-time oww_ token and expiry for begin, and the poll signal or combined close summary for window ops. Absorbs the deprecated names oracle_watch, oracle_watch_window_begin and oracle_watch_window_control. Metering: begin is 500 credits / $0.500 for the 24h window; in-window poll and close are covered (0 credits); snapshot and history are C3 (20 credits / $0.020).

tools.name: position_lifecycle
tools.description: Use it to buy a 24h Position Lifecycle bundle and run the guard, receipt and close steps inside it. Each call selects the branch with "op": begin, guard, receipt or close. Do not use it for a single pre-trade guard (use trade_guard op check_safety), for unrelated positions, or with a token after close. Returns the lifecycleId plus one-time plc_ token and expiry for begin, and the guard verdict, signed execution receipt or combined lifecycle summary for the in-window steps. Absorbs the deprecated names position_lifecycle_begin and position_lifecycle_step.

tools.name: prepare_perp_order
tools.description: Prepare an unsigned perpetual order for one reviewed venue, without signing or submitting it. Venue decides the artifact shape: hyperliquid returns an unsigned exchange order envelope (HyperCore); synthetix-perps-v3-base returns EVM calldata for commitOrder whose acceptablePrice is derived from Insight cross-oracle consensus, not the Synthetix mark price; aster-perps-bnb-mainnet returns a canonical centralized REST order payload (not calldata, and it proves payload binding rather than on-chain execution); solana_drift returns a Borsh instruction payload that the caller must complete with the Drift SDK. The reviewed guard runs inside each adapter, so the result carries the risk verdict reference. Use it when an agent has decided on venue, market, side and size. Do not use it to create a nonce, sign, or submit an order. Returns the shared prepared-execution envelope: `state` (READY, CAUTION, REQUIRES_COMPLETION, BLOCK or UNAVAILABLE), a payload whose `kind` is `evm-transaction`, `venue-rest-order`, `solana-instruction` or null, a required `validity_anchor` (timestamp, EVM block, Solana block height or venue policy), caller requirements and the guard verdict reference. It never returns a uniformly described executable trade package, and a payload that still needs caller completion is never labelled READY. A `venue-rest-order` payload exposes `execution_binding` with `proves_onchain_execution: false` and the `signing` requirement. Solana message payloads carry `transactionHash` (sha256 of the exact unsigned bytes, byte binding only, not signature-verifiable) and `messageHash` (null when the message segment cannot be derived). Deprecated alias: prefer trade_guard with op "prepare_perp_order". Removed on 2027-01-06.

Use it only after the trade settled. Do not use it before execution and do not treat the verdict as principal authorization. Returns a signed receipt or settlement with FAITHFUL/DEVIATED/NOT_EXECUTED/UNDETERMINED (or settlement status), price delta, binding ids and verify URL. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_proof with op "issue_receipt". Removed on 2027-01-06.

tools.name: verify_evidence
tools.description: Verify signed evidence produced by Insight or by an agent: a pre-trade/execution pair, a Base agent-swap settlement, a Solana swap settlement, or one Hyperliquid order/fill record. Use it when a third party needs to check binding and signatures before trusting a claim. Do not use it to re-assess oracle risk or to authorize trading. Returns valid/invalid, the closed-loop or settlement status, binding assertions and machine-readable reasons. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_proof with op "verify_evidence". Removed on 2027-01-06.

tools.name: oracle_watch

Do not use it for continuous monitoring — buy a 24h window with oracle_watch_window_begin. Returns the current trust signal (or the requested history series) with provider participation and freshness. Deprecated alias: prefer oracle_watch_window with op "snapshot". Removed on 2027-01-06.

Do not use it repeatedly for the same window and never share the token. Returns windowId, the oww_ token, the covered expiry and the credits charged. Poll returns a fresh signal at zero extra credits; close returns the complete window summary and the final signal. Use it only with a window token from oracle_watch_window_begin. Do not use it for a one-off snapshot (oracle_watch) and never reuse a token after close. Returns the signal (poll) or the combined summary (close).
